traefik.enable=true
traefik.docker.network=proxy
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a.rule=Host(`example.com`) && PathPrefix(`/a`)
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a.entrypoints=websecure
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a.priority=102
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a.service=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a
traefik.http.routers.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a.middlewares=${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-hsts
traefik.http.services.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-app-a.loadbalancer.server.port=3000
traefik.http.middlewares.${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-hsts.headers.stsSeconds=31536000
